mapper.sql: id, guid, code, name, description, version, schema_json, enabled, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hydra_device_generic_dev_schema (guid, code, name, description, version, schema_json, enabled, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{guid}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{version}, #{schemaJson}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE hydra_device_generic_dev_schema SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, version = #{version}, schema_json = #{schemaJson}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE guid = #{guid}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hydra_device_generic_dev_schema WHERE code = #{code} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM hydra_device_generic_dev_schema ORDER BY code ASC, version ASC
